7790.title: ACP command state exceeds the ingest byte budget
7790.rootCauseOneLine: ACP command mapping caps count but not serialized bytes, so server ingest replaces an oversized command state with a diagnostic.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only; root-cause approach matches evidence; linked branch not executed.

7790.proposedFix: Fit command-state JSON within the existing byte limit while preserving names and trimming descriptions; keep ingest validation.
7790.caveats: In-process mapping/ingest/projection reproduction, not a live ACP process, CLI, or browser run. Complete test is inline; site policy forbids separate test artifacts. No duplicate PR because #7791 is open.
